verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for an API/AI gateway, but the evidence documents no retention settings, retention windows, or deletion controls for logs, analytics, or AI traffic data. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: DLP/PII removal is content redaction rather than retention control, and log file locations and self-hosted deployment modes are not retention or deletion features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
